brief: Identify a contract’s renewal, cancellation and exit-cost terms before agreeing.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Contract Endings"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Lee cómo termina un contrato"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Leia como um contrato termina"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Identify a contract’s renewal, cancellation and exit-cost terms before agreeing.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A service can keep charging after the first period; check renewal, cancellation method and exit costs before agreeing.
instruction.misconception: Stopping use or deleting an app automatically cancels a renewing contract and removes every exit obligation.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Check automatic renewal, cancellation method and deadline, and any exit charge. Keep confirmation when cancellation is completed.
The clause requires cancellation to prevent renewal.
The specified process is different from removing the app.
Leaving early may trigger the explicitly stated exit charge.
Confirmation records the completed cancellation and its timing.
A free opening period can lead to later paid renewal.
Price alone does not explain how commitments can end.
